articles.summary: CAYCE, S.C. (Oct. 1, 2026) – Dominion Energy customers in Yemassee recently attended a kickoff event for the Neighborhood Energy Efficiency Program (NEEP). They are among the over 400 customers in the area who are eligible for free energy-saving products and services through NEEP, which offers home assessments, on-site education and installation of energy-efficient products to income-eligible customers.
